data.summary: At 9 in flight and limit 3, `ddflow next --phase bugs-2` blocks fix-B-ci-guards-unran-blocks-red-main with 'parallelism cap reached (fixed: limit 3, limited by reviewer latency ratio)', while `ddflow wait --item fix-B-ci-guards-unran-blocks-red-main --timeout 0` exits 0 with 'READY ... claim now'. The code comment in ddflow/api/lifecycle/wait.py and test_a_cap_blocked_item_wait_agrees_with_claim say claim does not apply the cap to a named item, but ddflow/templates/prompts/help/parallel.md says claim refuses 'when the parallelism caps are full' and that fixed means max_parallel_tasks 'is the limit', while the schedule.parallel knob says signals may lower it. So an agent cannot tell from ddflow whether the cap is a real stop, and next's waiting_on names a wait that never happens because wait returns at once.
data.title: Claim, wait, next and help disagree on whether the parallelism cap holds a named item

data.text:
Can a selected ci run on a red main conclude baseline-red without weakening B47a1dbeba0?
It cannot on the unfixed code, because _run_stages breaks after a failed selection, so ran.always stays unset and _guards_unran refuses; running the guards after a selection that ran and failed lets it conclude, provided the selection's exit stays the run's verdict.
_run_stages returns the last stage's run and _result takes the verdict from its exit code, so a guard pass after a red selection would read as a pass unless the selection's exit is kept. CommandRun reports a timeout as not ran, so stage verdicts split on p.ran.

data.how: Check with: cat .venv/lib/python3.13/site-packages/_editable_impl_ddflow_mcp.pth in the primary; it must name the primary checkout.
data.rule: In a task worktree run plain `uv run`, or call the tool from the worktree's own .venv. The shell exports VIRTUAL_ENV as the primary's .venv, so `uv run --active` syncs THAT venv to the worktree's project and rewrites _editable_impl_ddflow_mcp.pth. Every lane's `ddflow` then runs that worktree's code, and when the worktree is removed `ddflow` stops importing on the whole host.
data.title: Never run uv run --active in a worktree: it repoints the shared primary venv's editable install at that worktree
data.why: On 2026-11-05 sw-ciguards ran `uv run --active ruff` to silence uv's VIRTUAL_ENV warning. From 16:27:57Z all lanes ran fix-B-ci-guards-unran-blocks-red-main's tree, and from its removal at 16:58:50Z to the repair at 17:01:29Z `ddflow` failed with ModuleNotFoundError.
